rawSiteProfile.name: Londero Sports
rawSiteProfile.notes: Platform: Magento 2.x (verified: static/version1775485762 signature, no BCData, requirejs-config present). | Cloudflare firewall: plain HTTP 403 Sorry-you-have-been-blocked on ALL deep pages. Homepage (/en/) passes. Production fetchWithPlaywright renders successfully (CF JS challenge does not auto-resolve in 35s but final HTML contains content). | CRITICAL: previous profile had catalogUrls /firearms.html, /ammunition.html, /optics.html — these are 404/403 garbage. Real Magento URL keys do NOT use .html suffix on this install (e.g. /en/firearms/rifles). | Sort dropdown options (from <select id="sorter">): bestsellers (default), new, most_viewed, quantity_and_stock_status, price, marque, rating_summary, saving. The newest-first value is literally "new", NOT Magento standard "created_at". Verified: ?product_list_order=new changes first product from Maple Ridge Armoury (default bestsellers) to Weatherby Mark V Live Wild. | Pagination: Magento standard ?p=N. perPage=40. Rifles category has 913 items = 23 pages. | Firearm-sale leaves: rifles (913), shotguns (384), used-firearms (61). No handgun/pistol category — site does not sell restricted handguns. used-firearms parent aggregates used-rifles (40) + used-shotguns (17) + used-parts/used-muzzleloader (~4). | Total firearms catalog ~1358. DB currently has 394 active products (under-covered due to stale catalogUrls). | Product URL pattern: /en/<slug> (flat, no category breadcrumb segment, no .html). Extraction via production GenericRetailAdapter works correctly — no URL filter issues.

wafWorkaround.notes: Cloudflare firewall hard-blocks plain HTTP 403 on every deep page (category + sitemap). Cannot be bypassed with UA/header tuning. Production fetchWithPlaywright succeeds (CF challenge auto-times out at 35s but content renders after). Do NOT retry via axios — goes straight to Playwright.
